biggest_catch: Extremely skill-gated security work: most research produces no valid paid report, and only accepted vulnerabilities with a working PoC earn — the expected payout for a typical researcher is effectively $0. Never count this as reliable income.
catches: Highly skill-gated: most research yields no valid, payable report; expected payout for a typical researcher is effectively $0.

KYC is required for payouts; researchers in OFAC/UNSC-restricted countries are excluded.
Rewards are paid in USDC (crypto custody and tax implications apply) and denominated in USD.

steps: Set up a local test environment (local fork) — never test on mainnet or public testnets.
Research Immunefi's own smart contracts and platform for vulnerabilities.
Reproduce the issue and build a working Proof of Concept (PoC).
Submit the vulnerability report with the PoC through Immunefi's official reporting flow.
Complete KYC to receive payout; accepted reports are paid in USDC (denominated in USD).
timing: Ongoing bug-bounty program; official program page last updated 2026-09-09 (observed live 2026-09-23).
maximize: Official: ongoing bug-bounty program; rewards ($1k-$50k in USDC) paid after report triage, validation, and fix — typically weeks to months. Fastest path: submit a high-quality PoC for an in-scope critical bug. Blocker: triage/validation timeline is structural.
